* design scalable cloud\-based workflows and environments for media prep, post production operators to eliminate on prem downloads and accelerate content handling.
* integrate and operationalize solutions from external partners such as aws, lucidlink and other cloud or storage vendors to enhance automation and data throughput.
* collaborate with product, post production, and distribution operations teams to onboard, support and maintain automation and ai tooling.
* document system behavior, workflow metrics, and failure modes to ensure high reliability and adherence to on\-time and first\-time\-right delivery standards.
* serve as a primary escalation point for diagnosing and resolving complex audio/video issues throughout the content lifecycle.
* engage with external media partners to troubleshoot delivery issues, clarify technical requirements, and provide actionable solutions.
* utilize ticketing systems to log, track, and resolve issues related to machines, networks, file\-transfer systems, and workflow applications.
* monitor and analyze ai and automation trends within media and entertainment, translating insights into operational efficiencies and workflow enhancements.
* provide recommendations that improve throughput, reduce failure rates, and increase end\-to\-end automation coverage.

**responsibilities and duties of the role:**

* workflow optimization and implementation of automation within current processes supporting media asset prep and delivery operations
* technical troubleshooting, ticketing and training
* data i/o, asset prep and publishing

**required education, experience/skills/training:**


basic qualifications:


* bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
* minimum 3 years of experience in qc, automation, pipeline tools, or ai\-assisted production or post production technology and workflows or related experience
* proficiency with implementation of ai agent frameworks, aws services (including ec2\) and building automation workflows in cloud environments
* familiarity with python and json\-based data structures
* basic understanding of digital video specifications (uhd, hdr, dolby vision), timed text formats, and audio standards (dolby atmos, 5\.1, stereo).
* excellent problem\-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot technical issues under pressure.
* outstanding communication skills for collaborating with internal teams and external partners.
* ability to deliver high\-quality results in a heavy multitasking environment.

**preferred qualifications:**

* experience with ffmpeg, command\-line operations (osx/linux), mediainfo, emerging video/audio encoding technologies
* knowledge of video editing software and nles such as adobe premiere, colorfront transkoder, and davinci resolve
* experience with saas database products such as airtable, content management systems, ingest platforms, and high\-speed transfer services (e.g., aspera, signiant).

  


the hiring range for this position in glendale, ca is $97,500 to $130,700 per year. the base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. a bonus and/or long\-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered

title: Software Engineer IV
description:
**employment type:**  

full time
  
  

**shift:**  

day shift
  
  

**description:**  

trinity health iha medical group is hiring a software engineer iv role to lead meaningful, high\-impact engineering work in a healthcare environment, combining javascript development with intelligent automation to improve the daily experience of clinicians and administrative staff. as a technical leader in the automation\& software engineering team, you’ll own end\-to\-end delivery of internal solutions ranging from backend services and data integrations to user interfaces and automation that streamline complex administrative workflows, while setting engineering standards, mentoring teammates, and guiding critical design decisions. this position centers on robust application and service development, with the opportunity to explore and integrate microsoft azure capabilities including azure ai foundry, copilot studio, and document intelligence where they add practical value. you’ll thrive here if you enjoy partnering directly with stakeholders and using strong full\-stack and automation skills to deliver durable, real\-world improvements in how a healthcare organization operates.this position is hybrid
  
  

**position description:**  

the software engineer iv is a lead\-level software developer responsible for driving the strategic design, architecture, and delivery of complex applications and automation systems across the organization. this role requires expert\-level proficiency in technologies such as node.js, javascript frameworks (e.g., vue.js, react.js), python, and mssql, with the ability to architect modern, scalable and secure solutions across both full\-stack and automation domains.
  
depending on skills and project needs, the software engineer iv may focus on advanced automation using python, enterprise\-scale full\-stack development. engineers at this level play a pivotal role in the development of ai\-driven tools, including enterprise\-grade chatbots and intelligent workflow automation, helping shape the organization’s approach to technology\-enabled transformation.
  
operating with a high level of autonomy, the software engineer iv leads cross\-functional initiatives, establishes coding standards and architectural principles, and guides platform\-level decisions that impact multiple teams and systems. this role includes mentoring across engineering stacks, serving as a resource for complex problem\-solving, and partnering with stakeholders to ensure technical initiatives align with strategic business goals. through technical leadership and innovation, the software engineer iv ensures that the organization’s software and automation systems are robust, forward\-thinking and designed to deliver long\-term business value.
  
  

**essential job functions:**  

defines and leads the architecture of complex, cross\-functional software and automation systems, ensuring scalability, security and maintainability. develops strategic approaches for ai\-enabled applications, including enterprise\-grade chatbots and intelligent workflow automation. establishes, documents, and enforces engineering best practices across teams to promote consistency, quality and long\-term maintainability. designs, implements, and reviews mission\-critical services using technologies such as node.js, python, andmssql, with a focus on performance and reliability. provides technical leadership on long\-term product and platform evolution, influencing architectural direction and technology adoption. collaborates with executive, product, and operational stakeholders to align technical initiatives with strategic business objectives. ensures robust testing practices are implemented across teams, including unit, integration and automated testing strategies. guides teams through major design decisions, risk assessments and technical trade\-offs, balancing innovation with stability. drives organization\-wide initiatives related to code quality, observability, devops maturity and engineering efficiency. mentors engineers across all levels, fostering a high\-performance, inclusive and growth\-oriented engineering culture. champions the evaluation and adoption of emerging technologies, identifying opportunities to enhance innovation and business value. reviews and contributes to technical documentation, ensuring alignment with team standards and clarity of architectural strategies. consistently produces top\-tier production\-ready code with efficiency, setting the example for productivity across the development team, and ensuring project deliverables are met or exceeded.
  
  

**organizational expectations:**  

creates a positive, professional, service\-oriented work environment for staff, patients and family members by supporting the mission and values of trinity health medical group. must be able to work effectively as a member of the information systems team. assumes responsibility for performance of job duties in the safest possible manner, to assure personal safety and that of coworkers, and to report all preventable hazards and unsafe practices immediately to management. successfully completes all relevant organizational training and adheres to trinity health medical group standard of care as outlined in the trinity health code of conduct. maintains knowledge of and complies with trinity health medical group standards, policies and procedures. maintains general knowledge of trinity health medical group office services and in the use of all relevant office equipment, computer and manual systems. maintains strict confidentiality in compliance with trinity health medical group and hipaa guidelines. serves as a role model by demonstrating exceptional ability and willingness to take on new and additional responsibilities. embraces new ideas and respects cultural differences. uses resources efficiently. if applicable, responsible for ongoing professional development – maintains appropriate licensure/certification and continuing education credentials, participates in available learning opportunities.
  
  

**measured by:**  

performance that meets or exceeds iha cares values expectation as outlined in iha performance review document, relative to position.
  
  

**essential qualifications:**  

**education:** bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field; or equivalent experience demonstrating advanced software engineering and architectural capabilities.
  
**minimum experience:** minimum of 7 years of professional software development experience, including significant contributions to system architecture, cross\-functional initiatives, and enterprise\-scale solutions.
  
  

**position requirements (abilities\& skills):**  

expert\-level proficiency in javascript/typescript, node.js, python, and mssql, with a history of delivering scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions. extensive experience with modern javascript frameworks such as vue.js and react, including architectural design and performance optimization. proven ability to design and implement restful apis and microservices for enterprise applications. deep understanding of git\-based workflows, automated testing strategies, and ci/cd pipelines in large\-scale environments. hands\-on experience integrating ai/ml technologies, including generative and agentic ai (e.g., chatgpt), into production systems. advanced knowledge of cloud platforms (azure, aws, gcp), including infrastructure design, deployment automation, and cost optimization. strong grasp of application performance tuning, security best practices and advanced debugging techniques. demonstrated success leading cross\-functional engineering initiatives and mentoring developers across all levels. experience driving technical strategy and aligning engineering efforts with organizational goals. passion for innovation and continuous improvement, with a track record of staff, management, providers, provider and executive leadership, patients and family members, insurance carriers, vendors and trinity health. displays a courteous and friendly demeanor within all levels of the organization, vendors and the general public. excellent organizational and time management skills to effectively juggle multiple priorities, time constraints and large volumes of work. ability to exercise sound judgement and problem\-solving skills.ability to handle patient, michigan medical group staff and organizational information in a confidential manner. ability to travel to other office sites. successful completion of iha competency\-based program within introductory and training period.

physical activity that often requires keyboarding and phone work. physical activity that often requires extensive time working on a computer and sitting. physical activity that sometimes requires walking, standing, bending, stooping, reaching, climbing, kneeling and/or twisting. physical activity that sometimes requires lifting, pushing and/or pulling over 20 lbs. specific vision abilities required include close vision, depth perception, peripheral vision and the ability to adjust and focus. manual dexterity sufficient to operate a keyboard, photocopier, telephone, calculator and other office equipment. must hear and speak well enough to conduct business over the telephone or face to face for long periods of time in english.

this job operates in both an office environment and in a medical facility and requires regular walking to various locations around the hospital/clinic. it involves frequent interruptions, competing priorities and significant interaction with people which can be stressful at times. this position requires flexibility with days and hours, along with ability to be on\-call and travel as needed (including nights and weekends as appropriate).

title: Senior Software Engineer I - Finance
description:
job id: 110020
atlanta  


do you want to do work that matters, alongside supportive leaders who will help you grow faster than you ever thought possible? are you a creative problem\-solver who is energized by challenges? you’ve come to the right place.


your impact


you will take ownership of the frontend development and deployment of finiq, a generative ai tool that gives finance analysts and other user groups accurate analyses, visualizations, and valuable insights into firm operations driven by mckinsey’s finance data.


you will partner with data scientists, data engineers, analytics and metrics subject matter experts, and other stakeholders to deliver strategically important, cloud\-based ai capabilities. you will build strong partnerships with subject matter experts and finance stakeholders to understand business requirements, and you will design and develop a robust, chat\-based web application using react and next.js, complete with highly efficient restful apis, and complex, interactive dashboards. serving as a trusted source of expertise on deployment, you will work side\-by\-side with finance data experts to accomplish reliable production deployment of the finiq tool, and you will contribute to technical documentation and training to ensure users’ success once it is live.


your work will help solve some of the firm’s most difficult global and regional data\-driven operational challenges—putting accurate, ai\-driven insights from firm finance data directly into the hands of the analysts and leaders who depend on them every day.


you will be based in one of our locations in the americas or india as part of our analytics \& insights team. our team develops innovative data science models, ai tools, and advanced reporting solutions for a wide variety of internal stakeholders, helping to solve some of mckinsey's most difficult global and regional data\-driven operational challenges and to deliver sophisticated insights at scale for partners and other firm leaders worldwide.


your growth


you are someone who thrives in a high\-performance environment, bringing a growth mindset and entrepreneurial spirit to tackle meaningful challenges that have a real impact.


in return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we’ll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities to help you quickly broaden your expertise, grow into a well\-rounded professional, and contribute to work that truly makes a difference.


when you join us, you will have:

* continuous learning: our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. the real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast\-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
* a voice that matters: from day one, we value your ideas and contributions. you’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. we not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
* global community: with colleagues across 65\+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions. plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
* exceptional benefits: on top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well\-being for you and your family.

your qualifications and skills


degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or a related field; master’s degree preferred


5\+ years of professional experience in full\-stack development using modern web frameworks


expert proficiency in react, next.js, typescript, and state management libraries (rxjs)


advanced skills in python development, including application deployment


proven experience designing and implementing highly efficient restful apis using fastapi


expertise in building and styling robust ui systems using modern frameworks and tools (tailwind css, storybook)


hands\-on experience with production deployments, utilizing docker, ci/cd pipelines, and cloud platforms (aws preferred)


experience with relational databases (sql) and developing robust data processing pipelines and building complex, interactive dashboards and data\-heavy user interfaces


experience with automated testing frameworks, including jest and react testing library


knowledge of information security, secure infrastructure and capability design for cloud deployment, and security best practices


experience and ability to work with geographically dispersed teams and to work in\-person (team schedules and office locations may vary)


superior communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to communicate crisply and clearly with integrity and professionalism in dealing with confidential information


please review the additional requirements regarding essential job functions of mckinsey colleagues.
our unwavering commitment to integrity drives everything we do, guiding us to always act in the best interests of our clients, our people, and the communities we serve.

title: Sr. Software Engineer
description:
we are subway headquarters! a dedicated team of professionals supporting thousands of franchisees around the globe.
  
  

sr. software engineer, middleware
  
shelton, ct or miami, fl
  
  

why join subway?
  
at subway, we are not standing still. we are building.
  
  

**this is a business focused on what matters most:** growing franchisee profitability, strengthening our brand and creating long\-term value. the people who thrive here are the ones who want to make a real impact.
  
  

you will not just do the work. you will shape it.
  
  

we move fast. we think like owners. we make decisions that matter. we hold ourselves to a high standard because what we do directly impacts thousands of franchisees around the world.
  
  

if you bring energy, accountability and a bias for action, you will fit right in.
  
we take the work seriously, but we also know the best results come from teams that support each other, celebrate wins and show up ready to build something better every day.
  
this is your chance to be part of what’s next.
  
  

about this role
  
subway is on a mission to build a world\-class digital platform that serves millions of guests and thousands of franchise locations globally. the senior software engineer, middleware is a key technical contributor on the team that powers the integration layer connecting subway’s front\-end applications (ios, android, web, kiosk) with our internal and external partner systems.
  
  

you’ll design, build, and maintain high\-performance apis and services on aws, collaborating closely with product, architecture, and partner engineering teams. you’ll also own integrations with major third\-party delivery and marketplace platforms — including doordash, uber eats, and similar partners — ensuring seamless order flow, menu synchronization, and operational reliability across channels.
  
  

this is a hands\-on engineering role with real ownership. ai\-assisted development is a core part of how our team works — you’ll be expected to leverage tools like github copilot and claude daily to accelerate delivery, improve code quality, and solve complex problems faster.
  
  

**responsibilities:**  

* design, develop, and document new and enhanced apis as part of the subway middleware platform, supporting both internal system integration and external partner connectivity.
* leverage ai\-assisted development tools (github copilot, claude, and similar) as a core part of daily engineering work — from code generation and refactoring to test coverage and documentation. champion ai tooling adoption across the team.
* build and maintain integrations with third\-party delivery and marketplace partners (e.g., doordash, uber eats, and similar platforms), ensuring reliable order flow, menu synchronization, and real\-time operational data exchange.
* collaborate with business stakeholders and product teams to understand functional and technical requirements; translate those into scalable, maintainable architecture and implementation plans.
* conduct constructive code reviews and provide technical design guidance to peers and junior engineers, raising the overall quality and consistency of team output.
* enforce data governance, security policies, and compliance standards throughout the software development lifecycle.


technology stack
  
our middleware platform is built on the following core technologies. strong familiarity with this stack is expected:
  
aws lambda api gateway dynamodb sqs / sns node.js / typescript
  
terraform / iac github / ado dynatrace / apm openapi / swagger ai code assistants
  
  

required qualifications
  
education
  
* bachelor’s degree or higher in computer science, software engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)


experience
  
* 5\+ years of hands\-on production software development experience
* demonstrated experience building and operating restful and/or graphql apis at scale
* strong proficiency in one or more of: javascript/typescript (node.js), java, or c\#
* experience with serverless architectures on aws (lambda, api gateway, dynamodb, sqs/sns)
* solid understanding of integration patterns: event\-driven architecture, webhooks, async messaging, and pub/sub
* experience integrating with third\-party platforms and vendor apis (e.g., delivery aggregators, pos systems, loyalty platforms, or similar ecosystem partners)
* proficiency with ai\-assisted development tools (github copilot, claude, or equivalent) — must be comfortable using ai daily to write, review, refactor, and document code
* experience with ci/cd pipelines and source control workflows (git, github actions, azure devops)
* familiarity with infrastructure as code (terraform or cloudformation)


skills \& competencies
  
* strong debugging, root\-cause analysis, and production incident management skills
* excellent verbal and written communication, including technical documentation and stakeholder\-facing artifacts
* ability to translate ambiguous business requirements into clear technical specifications
* collaborative mindset with a willingness to give and receive candid code review feedback


preferred qualifications
  
* direct experience integrating with doordash drive, uber eats, or other major delivery/marketplace platform apis
* experience with multi\-region aws deployments and global traffic management (akamai, cloudfront)
* familiarity with identity and authentication patterns: oauth 2\.0, openid connect, aws cognito
* hands\-on experience with observability platforms (dynatrace, datadog, cloudwatch)
* experience prompting, fine\-tuning, or orchestrating llms/ai agents as part of a software delivery workflow
* experience in qsr, retail, or e\-commerce domains
* aws certified developer – associate or higher
* exposure to react native or cross\-platform mobile app integration patterns


what you’ll be part of
  
subway’s digital \& consumer technology team is in the middle of a major platform transformation — migrating legacy systems to modern cloud\-native architecture, building new consumer experiences across mobile, web, and kiosk, and expanding our global digital footprint. you’ll join a team that:
  
* ships production code that reaches millions of guests every day
* owns the full stack from design through deployment and operation
* values engineering quality, documentation, and technical craft
* is actively growing in\-house capability and reducing reliance on external vendors
* moves fast but maintains high standards for reliability, security, and scalability


what do we offer?
  
* insurance plans (medical, life)
* pension/401k/rsp (country specific)
* competitive bonus
* mobility allowance
* tuition reimbursement
* company holidays
* volunteering time
* and more…..


the company is only considering applicants who are currently authorized to work in the country the position is based. aa/eoe/d/v

description:
about the role
  
as a forward deployment engineer, you will make an impact by designing, developing, and deploying innovative generative ai\-powered solutions that accelerate software delivery, improve developer productivity, and transform enterprise engineering workflows. you will be a valued member of the engineering team and work collaboratively with product teams, business stakeholders, platform engineering teams, and client partners to integrate genai capabilities into modern software development environments. based on the cognizant global job posting template, this posting focuses on the most critical responsibilities and qualifications required for success in the role.
  
work model
  
this is a hybrid role based on business requirements in charlotte, nc and/or irving, tx. regardless of work arrangement, we support a healthy work–life balance through our wellbeing programs.
  
the working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. this may change based on the project you’re engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.
  
  

**important disclaimers:**  

**\*\*please note:** a few of our roles may require in\-person interviews at cognizant offices or client locations, depending on project or client needs.\*\*
  
\*\*candidate must be legally authorized to work in the united states without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future\*\*
  
  

**in this role, you will:**  

design, develop, and deploy generative ai\-powered applications and engineering solutions using leading ai platforms and tools.
  
integrate ai and developer productivity tools into enterprise software development lifecycle (sdlc) workflows, including ci/cd pipelines and engineering platforms.
  
partner with cross\-functional teams to accelerate product delivery, improve engineering efficiency, and enhance the end\-to\-end application lifecycle.
  
lead adoption, enablement, and best practices for generative ai technologies, including prompt engineering, agent\-based workflows, and ai\-assisted development.
  
provide hands\-on technical leadership, troubleshooting, performance optimization, and scalable implementation support across enterprise environments.

title: Senior Software Engineer - API & MCP Platform
description:
zoominfo is where careers accelerate. we move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life. you'll be surrounded by teammates who care deeply, challenge each other, and celebrate wins. with tools that amplify your impact and a culture that backs your ambition, you won't just contribute. you'll make things happen–fast.


zoominfo is where careers accelerate. we move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life. you'll be surrounded by teammates who care deeply, challenge each other, and celebrate wins. with tools that amplify your impact and a culture that backs your ambition, you won't just contribute. you'll make things happen–fast.



as a senior software engineer on the api \& mcp platform team, you'll be at the forefront of building and scaling zoominfo's api infrastructure that handles millions of api calls weekly and powers integrations across our platform. you'll work with java and nestjs to develop robust, secure, and high\-performance api services that enable seamless connectivity for our customers and partners.



you'll design and implement scalable api architectures, establish best practices for api security and authentication, and build infrastructure that enables partners and customers to leverage zoominfo's data at scale. your expertise in api design, oauth 2\.0, and emerging technologies like model context protocol (mcp) will be essential in creating world\-class developer experiences.



our engineering culture values diversity, intellectual curiosity, problem\-solving, and openness. we encourage collaboration, big thinking, and calculated risk\-taking in a blame\-free environment. you'll have the autonomy to work on meaningful projects while receiving the support and mentorship needed to grow your career.


**what you'll do:**
-------------------


* design, develop, and maintain scalable restful apis using java and nestjs framework
* build apis that power company and contact data enrichment, search, and intelligence capabilities
* architect and implement secure authentication and authorization systems using oauth 2\.0
* build high\-performance api gateways with advanced rate limiting, throttling, and quota management
* design and implement mcp (model context protocol) tools and servers to enable ai\-powered integrations
* establish and enforce api design standards, versioning strategies, and best practices across the organization
* optimize api performance, caching strategies, and response times for high\-volume traffic (millions of calls daily)
* design and implement comprehensive api documentation, sdks, and developer tools
* create mcp tool schemas, implement prompt best practices, and optimize tool discovery patterns
* collaborate with product and integration teams to define api contracts and service\-level agreements (slas)
* implement monitoring, logging, and analytics for api usage patterns and performance metrics
* participate in code reviews and mentor team members on api and mcp best practices
* troubleshoot and resolve production issues in distributed api systems
* contribute to technical architecture decisions for api platform evolution

**what you bring:**
-------------------


* bachelor's degree in computer science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 5\+ years of experience in software development with strong focus on api development
* 3\+ years of experience designing and implementing restful apis and microservices at scale
* strong expertise in java frameworks (spring boot, spring security, maven/gradle)
* strong expertise in nestjs framework
* deep understanding of oauth 2\.0, openid connect, jwt, and api security best practices
* experience with api gateway technologies
* proficiency with api design patterns, versioning, and documentation (openapi/swagger)
* strong knowledge of rate limiting, throttling, and api scalability strategies
* understanding of distributed systems and high\-availability architectures
* experience with mcp (model context protocol) tool creation and implementation

**preferred qualifications:**
-----------------------------


* experience releasing production mcp tools and servers
* deep knowledge of mcp best practices, prompt engineering, and tool design patterns
* familiarity with ai/llm integration patterns and context management
* experience with cloud platforms (aws, gcp, or azure)
* knowledge of containerization and orchestration (docker, kubernetes)
* experience with ci/cd pipelines and automated api testing
* familiarity with message queuing systems (kafka, rabbitmq)
* experience building developer portals and api documentation platforms
* background in platform engineering or developer experience (dx) initiatives
* active contributions to open\-source api projects or mcp tool repositories
